title: Decades behind competitors
body: Jumbled mess of a UI. Shamelessly expects you to hand over your health data to 3rd parties for basic watch-integrated functions like calorie tracking, weightlifting logs, running routes, water, alcohol, caffeine etc. with often exorbitant individual subscriptions while completely nullifying Apple’s privacy promises. No option to change day-start time, meaning daily medication reminders and activity rings don’t work for anyone who sleeps after midnight. No medication database outside the US while still falsely claiming to screen for interactions. No option to upload clinical documents outside the US. No cross-referencing of data for insights no matter how much you input (e.g. habit X influences sleep, medication Y elevates heart rate). Unclear distinction/overlap with Fitness app. Sleep score is crudely calculated and having any sort of nap breaks it. Poor visibility as to what data is stored before it is compressed/deleted. It’s like none of the devs have even used the app. It’s an insult to the amazing hardware the Apple Watch engineers are creating. ‘Just works’ was true for Apple 10 years ago, not anymore.

title: Unpleasant and Pleasant are not moods
body:
I was immediately switched off the mood tracker when I was asked to select a position on a slider, to match my mood, between unpleasant and pleasant. 

Are you seriously asking me to record how I perceive others perceive me on a scale of unpleasant to pleasant??? Does no one in America speak proper English any more? Does no one understand that pleasant is not a mood? 

Did you mean to say on a scale from displeased to pleased? Without context unhappy to happy would be better, but at least displeased to pleased would make sense. 

Its pathetic that an app distributed to 10s of millions contains such basic errors.

Desperately simplistic. You can’t even enter your own words for how you feel. AS? (Artificially Stupid????)

title: Edits???
body:
One BIG problem this app: it’s easy to make an error adding data manually. But if you save that — add it — and you see it’s wrong: you cannot fix your mistake. There’s no editing function,  or even delete (and start again). 

Example: Sleep, which I often amend as neither Health nor my Fitbit knockoff record it accurately — I’m of an age when going to the bathroom during the night is the norm. I may then add, say, sleep from 11.30 pm to 4.09am, but without me noticing the app makes this 4.09pm — therefore asleep for around 17 hours rather than the actual 8.25.

Can you please provide an edit/ delete/ change function??
